purpose: Make every evaluation result state its scorecard/profile scope so Tenn does not overclaim canonical results.
global_rules: Every score must include scorecard_profile, document_count, metric_check_count, and source artifact path.
canonical_core is a no-regression profile only and must not be presented as broad production extraction coverage.
expanded_required is broader than canonical_core but still limited to the current required real-gold subset.
confirmed_metric_coverage is a breadth profile and must keep candidate, ambiguous, unsupported, and DATA_MISSING counts separate from extractor failures.
Runtime, route, source-label, memory, news, UI, and feedback profiles are not Financial Truth scorecards unless their source evidence and semantics explicitly say so.

dimensions.may_claim: canonical_core passed for the strict canonical subset only
dimensions.must_not_claim: production extraction coverage, broad ASX generalization, Tier 2/Tier 3 metric coverage, parser superiority, or live runtime reliability

dimensions.may_claim: expanded_required passed for the current required-metric subset
dimensions.must_not_claim: all schema-supported metrics, all production-relevant metrics, confirmed coverage for EBIT/NPAT/capex/cash/shares, or canonical KPI status unless policy allows

dimensions.scope: production-relevant breadth over confirmed source-evidenced schema-supported metrics
dimensions.may_claim: confirmed_metric_coverage reports breadth over confirmed schema-supported evidence
dimensions.must_not_claim: candidate rows are extractor failures, ambiguous rows are scored, or confirmed coverage changes canonical trust semantics

dimensions.scope: runtime/model/API health and bounded smoke behavior

current_evidence.source: APEX/M40 runtime stability and direct soak reports

dimensions.may_claim: direct local llama.cpp tiny prompt stability when the artifact proves it
dimensions.must_not_claim: Cockpit chat stability, long-context stability, extraction quality, or financial correctness from direct runtime smoke

dimensions.scope: route ownership and expected response semantics
dimensions.may_claim: a route is BFF-owned, backend-owned, intentionally absent, expected 404, or stale expectation
dimensions.must_not_claim: missing endpoint equals product failure when current contract says expected absent

dimensions.scope: source label, no-hit, missing evidence, and verified-support behavior

current_evidence.source: A2M trace and Cockpit chat source guard reports

dimensions.may_claim: source labels were preserved or missing evidence was honestly surfaced for the checked path
dimensions.must_not_claim: claim_verified when evidence is only memory_context/context_only or when source matching is missing

dimensions.scope: memory contamination, duplicate/fanout inventory, and surfacing risk

current_evidence.source: memory contamination root-cause and live inventory reports

dimensions.may_claim: active contamination counts, duplicate/fanout counts, cleanup readiness, and untrusted-memory risk when read-only live inventory proves them
dimensions.must_not_claim: memory context is financial truth or a source-verified financial claim

dimensions.scope: news ingestion to retrieval to source-label path trace

current_evidence.source: A2M news trace audit and active A2M live-trace task context

dimensions.may_claim: static or live trace status per stage when artifacts prove it
dimensions.must_not_claim: live Qdrant/news SQLite state from static-only code inspection

dimensions.scope: UI/BFF representation of partial, missing, expected empty, or unavailable features

current_evidence.source: Cockpit Home missing producers and route parity reports

dimensions.may_claim: UI honestly exposes PARTIAL, DATA_MISSING, expected empty states, and route ownership
dimensions.must_not_claim: a section is ready when it uses mock data, stale docs, or absent producer output

dimensions.scope: future operator feedback and auto-diagnostic quality labels

current_evidence.source: visible reports/cockpit artifact plus Cockpit chat side-effect audit

dimensions.may_claim: feedback artifacts exist or are pending normalization
dimensions.must_not_claim: automatic score from sparse feedback or auto-diagnostic flags
